runtime_source_coherent_requires: At least one complete source receipt per dynamic case: source identity, response hash, provider quote timestamp, evaluator captured_at, session, timezone, currency, unit, freshness and tick.
One accepted variant uses one complete source. More sources may create alternative accepted variants only; never average or cross-source splice.
An invalid or absent receipt marks only that case Data Accuracy not_scored.
admission_rule.replay_fixture_rule: A replay fixture may support deterministic regression only. It must use snapshot_mode=replay_fixture and evaluation_use=non_formal_replay_only; it never contributes to formal data_accuracy or rankings.
admission_rule.hard_scoring_exclusion: Candidate provider tool parameters are not a hard-scoring target.

conclusion: Static request contracts and state-only Oracles are frozen. No dynamic value receipt is stored here; the current Runner cannot collect one.
